box.label: DATA SAFETY
box.text: Use an approved tool only. Do not put client data, health data protected by HIPAA or personal data (PII) into a tool your company has not approved. Get consent before you record an interview. Agree confidentiality for win/loss.

slides.title: Lab 2: Add the win/loss job
slides.lead: Build and save your own agent. Share your screen only when someone is stuck.
items: Add 2 files: 0 to 4. Half day 0 to 4.
Run: 4 to 11. Half day 4 to 11.
Decide each flag: 11 to 16. Half day 11 to 16.
Audit: 16 to 23. Half day 16 to 24.
Add your rule: 23 to 26. Half day 24 to 28.
Run again, new chat: 26 to 32. Half day 28 to 34.
